data.leadership_messages: We have moderate confidence in the planning foundation for development of schedule artifacts. Open communication and a solid relationship will enable collaborative discussions, but schedules in previous years that were missing key logic or scope leave us with some definite concerns that we will be looking for in future evaluations.

areas.text: The government has moderate confidence in the cross-function integration at this time. Because the training system is heavily dependent on the Weapon System, it is going to be critical to continue the integration within other segments. We are encouraging NG to reach out to the other segments while designing/developing the training system. NG has demonstrated their approach by creating internal planning documents that are being socialized to other NG entities. We would expect to see a similar approach across all divisions in the future.
